title: Blackthorn_City
lead_summary:
Blackthorn City can be accessed by the Dark Cave from the South and by the Ice Mountains from the North.
This city contains Blackthorn City's Gym, with Clair as its leader.

expertPokemon6EVDef=4 | expertPokemon6EVSpA=0 | expertPokemon6EVSpD=0 | expertPokemon6EVSpe=0 }} ==Points of Interest== ===Dragon's Den=== The Dragon's Den is located in the cave behind the Gym. The player must surf across the water to reach the Dragon Shrine at the end, navigating through whirlpools that will push the player back. Obtaining the Rising Badge makes the Dragon's Den challenge easier. In the shrine is an old woman who gives the player a Gible the first time she is spoken to. ====Reset Karma==== When interacting with the Old lady after receiving the Gible, she will give the player the choice to reset their [[Karma]] by donating ₽5,000. ====Clair Rematch==== After clearing [[Mt. Silver]], Clair can be found in the shrine during the [[Time|night]]. After talking to her, she will appear at the Fighting Arena in [[Vermillion City]] for a [[Gym Leader rematches|rematch]].
